verdict.rationale: Self-hosting with a replicated, highly available deployment is a fair question for a code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted GitHub instance or any replication or HA configuration. The only self-hosting mentions are community references to other forges (e.g. self-hosted Forgejo), which do not count as GitHub's own capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy a self-hosted instance in a replicated, highly available configuration
